modules.title: Sample Module: Preparing for Baptism
modules.description: Demonstration module: discuss baptismal preparation with church leaders and use the congregation’s approved teaching.
modules.introduction: This sample module presents questions for a guided conversation. It is not a substitute for the church’s baptismal teaching or pastoral guidance.

lessons.title: Questions to discuss
lessons.content: What does baptism mean in your congregation? What practical arrangements, consent and support are needed? Which church leader can answer questions?

discussionQuestions: What questions would you like to ask before baptism?
How can the congregation support a person before and after the service?
reviewQuestions: Name one question you want to discuss with a church leader.
modules.conclusion: Invite learners to speak with an authorized church leader about local teaching, scheduling and participation.

modules.title: Sample Module: A Community of Support
modules.description: A discussion guide about learning and belonging within a church community.
modules.introduction: Use this sample as a conversation starter and supplement it with approved local course materials.

lessons.title: Growing together
lessons.content: Discuss how a community can offer practical care, welcome questions and respect personal boundaries.

discussionQuestions: What kinds of support help a person feel connected?
How can a congregation offer help without pressure?
reviewQuestions: Name one trusted person or church contact you could approach with a question.
modules.conclusion: Agree on one appropriate next conversation with a course leader.
